summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares preinstall `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs detects platform/libc, downloads Bun v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unpacks and chmods the runtime executable, and invokes the sibling file `math_init.js` under that freshly-fetched Bun binary via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a rotated string-array (`WV8StW` rotator and a large numeric/string table) and hex-mangled identifiers — the obfuscator.io shape. The package advertises itself as a React marketing-widget library, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install and use it to run an opaque bundled payload. The Bun-executed payload is not introspectable by Node-oriented tooling and runs with the installer's privileges at `npm install` time. The setup.mjs script itself is also variable-name-obfuscated, further hiding what is being launched.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
